notes.general_comments:
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 4, 5, 11, 13, 14, 18, 22, 24 and
30. These questions were answered correctly by 80 per cent or more of the candidates. They covered
different parts of the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 10, 23, 25, 26, and 27.
These questions were answered correctly by fewer than 50 per cent of the candidates.
